core_obligations: Use the descent triangle (proof lines 23410-23414): the blow-up descent lemma gives the distinguished triangle whose terms are K, Ri_*(K|_Z) + Rb_*(K|_{X'}) and Rc_*(K|_E).

Take global sections (proof lines 23415-23418): since R Gamma(X, Rb_*(K|_{X'})) = R Gamma(X', K|_{X'}) and similarly for the other pushforwards, the long exact cohomology sequence of the triangle is the displayed sequence, which is the assertion.
proof_roadmap: Quote the cohomological descent triangle of the blow-up square.
Identify the global sections of the pushforward terms and take the long exact sequence.

The proof (proof lines 23409-23418) takes the cohomological descent triangle of the square and identifies the global sections of its pushforward terms, giving the displayed sequence. H2: one triangle plus one identification.
